notes.title: Single player Survival Mode and more
notes.content:
Hey Chefs! 👨‍🍳🔥
We’ve just served up a hot new update for Kitchen Wars, and it’s packed with flavor!


🧪 Practice Mode
New to the chaos? Want to test your weapons and skills?
Practice Mode is here to let you explore the game mechanics without pressure.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/47f4287eeab80f15cbc762b5b1e0412f67d17479.gif"]


🧄 New Survival Mode (Single Player)
Defend your beloved kitchen from endless waves of attackers in our brand-new Single Player Survival Mode!
How long can you hold the line? How many waves can you survive?

Get your gloves, set those traps, and prepare for the ultimate solo kitchen showdown!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/090e5da385d694f4defffcdb4bc12033ed0f64ba.gif"]


❄️ New PvP Item: Frost Bomb
We’ve also added a new throwable item in PvP — the Frost Bomb! Freeze your enemies in place and serve up a cold dish of destruction!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/a3f2bb04c6dbc47a290479b58e7986302770c7a9.gif"]


🏆 Global Leaderboard
Track your score and see how you stack up against other culinary warriors!
Survive longer, score higher, and climb the leaderboard for ultimate bragging rights.

🛠️ Challenges and prizes will be added soon , so keep an eye out!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/9f3a6caebd2588b8bf9387121ead0548d6de7e32.gif"]



Get back in the kitchen and show the world who’s the true master of the chaos!
Update your game now and let the food fight begin!

👨‍🍳 Team Kitchen Wars

notes.title: Update V0.6.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181785/ce978b175cbfcae292f58ab9017f6e735c8ee5fb.png




 Various bug fixes.
 Improved gameplay visibility.
 Added rematch button at the end of the game.
 You can briefly pickup enemy players in their own restaurant.
 Restaurants no longer take damage from empty chair spots when low on health.
 Added a "Hide Room Code" option for streaming.

notes.content:

Hey chefs, warriors, and restaurant wreckers!
We’ve got spicy news straight from the kitchen…

🔥 Kitchen Wars officially launches on Steam on April 16th! 🔥
Grab your spatulas and sharpen your knives—this is not your average dinner service.

👨‍🍳 2-8 players
🏃‍♂️ Fast-paced party action (Online or Local Multiplayer)
🍔fight, steal & serve
🎉 Pure chaotic fun with friends (or foes!)

Whether you're sabotaging rival restaurants, stealing their chairs, or trying to deliver a burger while on fire, Kitchen Wars turns up the heat in every round.

Already tried the free demo, Kitchen Wars: Appetiser?
Then you know the madness that's about to unfold.
If not—what are you waiting for? Warm up those reflexes and get a taste of the action!

🗓️ Add Kitchen Wars to your Wishlist
🔔 Set a reminder
🎮 And get ready to serve mayhem on April 16!
